title: Instrumented CI lane has no guard against orchestrion-gated tests silently skipping
claim: All instrumentation-dependent tests t.Skip when !built.WithOrchestrion, and CI selects the woven lane only by orchestrion.tool.go presence. An unwoven run therefore passes green with every such test skipped. The research PR added a hard toolchain preflight for exactly this failure. dd-iast-go's bootstrap symbols.txt check and TestDatabaseSQLInstrumentedCount do not cover it.

title: Exact (pointer,length) identity keys make every alias created outside root-wrapped calls a silent false negative
claim: StringKey/BytesKey key on the exact data pointer and length. Unlike both research prototypes, which use address/range registries or per-byte shadow, sub-slice aliases produced by unwrapped code (regexp.FindString, dependency-internal reslices, method-value calls) lose provenance. This is documented as root-only direct-call coverage, and it is the largest coverage delta the research exposes.
